## Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear description of the problem. e.g. "There's no way to do [...] when using [...] provider."

## Describe the solution you'd like
What you want to happen — new API, new provider support, config option, etc.

## Describe alternatives you've considered
Any alternative solutions, workarounds, or existing libraries you compared.

## Additional context
Add any other context, links, or examples (e.g. how another SDK like
LiteLLM handles this) that would help evaluate the request.
